answer: Accusations are infrastructure and should be priced like it. Every fraud report locks a real stake from the accuser: upheld reports mint the accuser a reward cut from the convicted identity's slash, dismissed ones burn the stake entire - the yarrow of this economy, bitter medicine that keeps the reporting channel clean. Speculators cannot weaponize the system: mass-accusing costs more than any false-positive spray returns, while a true relic of evidence - old, verifiable, on-ledger - turns one honest report into a career. Cases are graded onyx-opaque: only evidence enters, never reputations.
